world.campaign_name: Biblechat CPT - US - IOS - August 06, 2026 - Arthur - New Ads
world.notes: Pulled with the facebook-ads MCP tool ads_get_ad_entities, two calls, both with time_range {"since":"2026-09-08","until":"2026-09-14"} (explicit dates, no preset). Call 1: level=adset, sort=amount_spent_descending, limit=30 -- the ad set was picked out of that page by name. Call 2: level=ad, filtering ad.adset_id EQUAL 120246661279120160, sort=amount_spent_descending, limit=100; 16 ads came back with no next_cursor, so that is the whole ad set. Field names were verified first with ads_get_field_context. RESULTS: the tool returns results.indicator = "conversions:app_custom_event.purchase_completed" and cost_per_result "$29.02 USD (purchase_completed)", so results maps to the app custom event purchase_completed -- 467 at ad-set level. This is NOT the same as Meta's generic purchase metric: omni_purchase (action_type app_custom_event.fb_mobile_purchase) is 337 at $40.21, recorded separately in counts.purchases. INSTALLS: yes, installs came through -- mobile_app_install = omni_app_install = 1560 ($8.69 each). ATTRIBUTION: the ad set's attribution_setting field reads 7d_click, and every results value is tagged attribution_windows ["default"], i.e. that same 7-day-click setting. No per-window breakdown was requested or returned. OPTIMIZATION: optimization_goal = OFFSITE_CONVERSIONS; promoted_object = {pixel_id: null, custom_event_type: "OTHER", pixel_rule: null}, so the specific event is not named in promoted_object -- purchase_completed is taken from the results indicator / cost_per_result label. NULLS: counts.trials is null -- the tool exposes no trial/start_trial field (unknown_fields on ads_get_field_context for start_trial, mobile_app_trial, trials_started); purchase_completed may or may not be the trial event, not verified here. Per-ad nulls: 10 of 16 ads returned results "Not available" and null installs -- Meta suppresses these on tiny volume, and 4 of them had zero spend and zero impressions, so those are null (not read), not verified zeros. RECONCILIATION: the 16 ad rows sum exactly to the ad-set totals (spend 13552.35, impressions 888895, link_clicks 17231, installs 1560, results 467, purchases 337, LPV 433) -- so nothing is missing despite the suppressed per-ad cells. DID NOT MATCH EXPECTATIONS: the brief said roughly $11.7k over the last 7 days and about 12 active ads; the pull returns $13,552.35 and 16 ads in the ad set (13 ACTIVE, 3 PAUSED), of which 12 had any spend. Spend is higher than expected -- possibly a different 7-day window was quoted. ODD: omni_landing_page_view = 433 is tiny next to 17,231 link clicks; for an iOS app-install destination LPV is not a meaningful step, treat it as noise rather than a funnel stage. Also note clicks (all) 17,549 is LOWER than link_click 17,231 only in aggregate; on one ad (77.seminar-yelling-0904-hookfetita-v4) link_click 11,236 exceeds clicks 10,941, which is a Meta reporting artifact, not a mapping error. Read-only pull; nothing was changed.
